y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Jiu ava kuda kutora pepa rekutanga. Bhokisi rine mapepa 10 uye 2 ari anokunda.
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Nzira chaiyo yekutsanangura mukana wekuti Jiu adhirowe pepa rinokunda ndeipi?
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Mapepa 2 pa10 anokunda, saka ndi1/5 yechose. Zvakarurama kutaura kuti uri pasi pemukana wakaenzana (1/2) uye hauzi hazvigoni (0). y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kune anokunda 2 chete, saka Jiu, anodhirowa pekutanga, haagoni kukunda
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Mukana mudiki nechinhu chisingagoni kuitika zvakasiyana. Mapepa anokunda ari mubhokisi.
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kune anokunda mashoma kupfuura asina chinhu, saka uri pasi pemukana wakaenzana asi hazvisi zvisingagoni
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafananidza huwandu hwevanokunda nevasina chinhu kutsanangura hukuru hwemukana. Wakauisa zvakanaka pakati pezvisingagoni nechokwadi.

y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Harin akadzorera chikwata chisina chinhu. Verenga iwe pachako kana huwandu hwuri mubhokisi hwakaderera.
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zvakafanana nepakanga paine zvikwata 10 pakutanga. Harin akadzorera chikwata chisina chinhu, saka zvose zvakadzokera pakutanga

y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kana chikadzorerwa, bhokisi rakafanana nepasati padhirowa Harin. Tarisa zviri mubhokisi, kwete kuti vanhu vangani vakadhirowa.
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Zvakafanana nepasati padhirowa Harin. Bhokisi rine zvikwata 9 uye 2 dzacho dzinokunda
y-m-15-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakaverenga iwe pachako huwandu hwezvikwata mubhokisi uye wakaenzanisa. Wakanongedza kuti kana chikwata chadzorerwa, bhokisi rinoita sepakare.
y-m-15-03.s.s1.reflect: Mukana waunga wakatanga kufunga wakachinja sei, kana kuramba wakafanana, pachikamu chega chega? Ruzivo rupi rwakachinja mukana, uye rupi rusina?

y-m-15-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana huwandu hwezvikwata zvinokunda hwakafanana kana hwakasiyana munyaya mbiri idzi.
y-m-15-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kana chisingadzorerwi, wakanyora here kuti chakachinja ndechipi, huwandu hwose hwezvikwata kana huwandu hwevanokunda?
y-m-15-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Munyaya yokudzorerwa, wakanyora here kuti bhokisi rinoita sei?
y-m-15-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Zvakajeka here kuti mukana wawakanyora wakava mukuru kupfuura wapakutanga (2/10) kana wakaramba wakafanana?
y-m-15-03.s.s2.model.0: Kana chisingadzorerwi, chikwata chimwe chisina chinhu chabuda, saka zvikwata 9 zvasara mubhokisi uye vanokunda vanoramba vari 2, saka mukana unokwira zvishoma. Kana chikadzorerwa, huwandu hwezvikwata hunoramba hwakafanana, saka mukana hauchinji.
y-m-15-03.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukadzorera chikwata chisina chinhu chawakabvisa, bhokisi rinodzokera sepakare, saka rinoramba riri 2/10. Kana usingachidzorere, rinochinja kuva 2/9 uye rinokwira zvishoma.

y-m-15-05.title: Kana tikatsvaga kuti vadzidzi 100 vanofungei nokubvunza vadzidzi 20
y-m-15-05.topic: Kutora data: kuenzanisa nzira dzokusarudza vanodzidziswa
y-m-15-05.goal: Enzanisa nzira dzakati wandei dzokusarudza chikamu kana kuongorora vose kuri kuoma, gadzira hurongwa hwako hunoparadzanisa huwandu hwevanhu kuti mhedzisiro isatsvedzere kudivi rimwe, uye utaure migumo yahwo.
y-m-15-05.material: Giredhi 5 rine Kirasi 1 ine vadzidzi 28, Kirasi 2 vadzidzi 26, Kirasi 3 vadzidzi 24, uye Kirasi 4 vadzidzi 22, vadzidzi 100 zvose. Dare revadzidzi rinoda kuziva ‘basa ravadzidzi vanoda zvikuru kuita panguva yokuzorora.’ Hapana nguva yakakwana yokubvunza vadzidzi vose 100 vega, saka vanoda kubvunza vadzidzi 20 chete. Unofanira kusarudza kuti ungasarudza sei vadzidzi 20 kubva panzira dziri pazasi.
y-m-15-05.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa nokuongorora kana nzira yehurukuro inotsvedzera kudivi rimwe
y-m-15-05.thinking.1: Kugadzira hurongwa hwakati wandei mukati memamiriro
y-m-15-05.prereq.0: Kuedza kuratidza data netafura nemagirafu emabhawa (nhanho yeGiredhi 4 kusvika 5)
y-m-15-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira inokubatsira zvakanyanya kuziva zvinofungwa nevadzidzi vose 100 vegiredhi 5 kubva pamhinduro dzevadzidzi 20.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, tarisa 'pane vadzidzi vasingagoni kusarudzwa here?' Tsvaga kuti vadzidzi vapi vasingatongosarudzwi.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa musiyano unoitika kana ukasarudza huwandu hwakafanana kubva pamakirasi ane huwandu hwevadzidzi hwakasiyana, se Kirasi 1 neKirasi 4.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.o.a: Enda utsvage vadzidzi vegiredhi 5 vaviri 20 vari paburaundi panguva yokuzorora uvavunze
y-m-15-05.s.s1.r.a: Vadzidzi vanobuda paburaundi vangatoinzwa kudivi rimwe mukusarudza basa. Vadzidzi vari mukirasi havaigoni kusarudzwa.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.o.b: Mukirasi imwe neimwe, sarudza nokusanganisa nhamba, asi sarudza kuti vangani vanofanira kusarudzwa kubva mukirasi imwe neimwe kuti zvienderane nehukuru hwekirasi
y-m-15-05.s.s1.r.b: Munhu wose ane mukana wokusarudzwa, uye hukuru hwemakirasi hunoratidzwawo. Yakashandisa pfungwa mbiri dzokudzikisa kutsvedzera pamwe chete.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.o.c: Sarudza kirasi imwe uye ubvunze vadzidzi 20 vomukirasi iyoyo
y-m-15-05.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa dzekirasi imwe dzinogona kusiyana nedzemamwe makirasi. Vadzidzi vemamwe makirasi havana mukana wokusarudzwa.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.o.d: Mukirasi imwe neimwe, bvunza vadzidzi 20 vane manhamba ekuwuya 1 kusvika 5
y-m-15-05.s.s1.r.d: Anosarudzwa anotoratidzwa nenhamba, saka vadzidzi vane nhamba 6 uye kupfuura havana mukana wokusarudzwa.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.o.e: Govera mibvunzo mipfupi kuvadzidzi vose 100 vegiredhi 5 uye utore uye uverenge
y-m-15-05.s.s1.r.e: Iyi ipfungwa yokusanganisa pfungwa dzevadzidzi vose. Inotora nguva nesimba zvakawanda, uye unofanira kufunga kuti vamwe vadzidzi vangasapa.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.explain: Kuti urege kutsvedzera kudivi rimwe, mudzidzi wose anofanira kuva nomukana wokusarudzwa, uye zvirinani kuratidza hukuru hwekirasi. Saka kudhirowa pakarepo mukirasi imwe neimwe, nenhamba kubva pakirasi imwe neimwe yakagadziriswa kuenzanisa huwandu hwevadzidzi, ndiyo nzira inokodzera. Kutora mibvunzo kubva kuvadzidzi vose 100 kunogonawo kushandiswa, asi kune migumo pasi pemamiriro okuti nguva ishoma.
y-m-15-05.s.s1.acc.0: Kana mibvunzo ichipfupika, kuitora kubva kuvadzidzi vose 100 inzira imwewo. Asi pasi pemamiriro okuti nguva ishoma, unofanira kuienzanisa nenzira yokusarudza vadzidzi 20 chete, uye utaure mugumo wokuti vamwe vadzidzi vangasapa mibvunzo.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira hurongwa 3 hwakasiyana hwokuti vadzidzi vangani vanosarudzwa kubva pakirasi imwe neimwe kuvadzidzi 20. Tora sokusarudza inenge 1 pa 5 yevadzidzi, uye huwandu hwakasarudzwa kubva pakirasi imwe neimwe hahufanire kusiyana nevadzidzi vanopfuura 1 kubva ku (huwandu hwevadzidzi mukirasi ÷ 5). Huwandu hwose ndi vadzidzi 20. (Kirasi 1 a, Kirasi 2 b, Kirasi 3 c, Kirasi 4 d)
y-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watsvaga huwandu hwevadzidzi hwekirasi imwe neimwe hwakaparadzanwa ne 5, uye utsvage nhamba dzizere dziri mukati memudzidzi 1 wadzo.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora nhamba dzinogoneka dzekirasi imwe neimwe, wobva watsvaga zvibatanidzwa zvinoita kuti nhamba nhatu dziwedzere kuita 20.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanosarudzwa inhamba dzechisikigo dziri 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanosarudzwa hunofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikigo dziri 0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vemakirasi mana hahuwedzeri kuita 20.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Nhamba yeKirasi 1 iri mukati memudzidzi 1 we 28÷5.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kirasi 1 inofanira kuiswa padhuze ne 28÷5 (mukati memudzidzi 1).
y-m-15-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Nhamba yeKirasi 2 iri mukati memudzidzi 1 we 26÷5.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Kirasi 2 inofanira kuiswa padhuze ne 26÷5 (mukati memudzidzi 1).
y-m-15-05.s.s2.ok.c5: Nhamba yeKirasi 3 iri mukati memudzidzi 1 we 24÷5.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c5: Kirasi 3 inofanira kuiswa padhuze ne 24÷5 (mukati memudzidzi 1).
y-m-15-05.s.s2.ok.c6: Nhamba yeKirasi 4 iri mukati memudzidzi 1 we 22÷5.
y-m-15-05.s.s2.fail.c6: Kirasi 4 inofanira kuiswa padhuze ne 22÷5 (mukati memudzidzi 1).
y-m-15-05.s.s2.explain: 28÷5=5.6, 26÷5=5.2, 24÷5=4.8, uye 22÷5=4.4. Saka Kirasi 1 ndi vadzidzi 5 kusvika 6, Kirasi 2 ndi 5 kusvika 6, Kirasi 3 ndi 4 kusvika 5, uye Kirasi 4 ndi 4 kusvika 5, uye pane hurongwa 6 hwose hunowedzera kuita vadzidzi 20. muenzaniso (5, 5, 5, 5), (6, 5, 5, 4), (6, 6, 4, 4).
y-m-15-05.s.s3.prompt: Nyora chikonzero 1 chokuti nzira yawakasarudza (kana hurongwa hwawakagadzira pamusoro) inobatsira kuratidza zvinofungwa negiredhi 5 rose, uye mugumo 1 unoramba uripo.
y-m-15-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kana paine vadzidzi vasingagoni kusarudzwa munzira yako.
y-m-15-05.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira mamiriro 1 umo mhedzisiro yevadzidzi 20 nemhedzisiro yevadzidzi vose 100 zvingasiyana.
y-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kana paine vadzidzi munzira yako vasina mukana wokusarudzwa?
y-m-15-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here kuti sei mhedzisiro yevadzidzi 20 ingasiyana nevose 100?
y-m-15-05.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukadhirowa nhamba pakarepo mukirasi imwe neimwe, zvakaenzana nehuwandu hwevadzidzi, mudzidzi wose ane mukana wokusarudzwa, saka hazvitsvedzeri kudivi rimwe. Zvakadaro, takabvunza vadzidzi 20 chete, saka mhedzisiro ingasiyana nokubvunza vose 100.
y-m-15-05.s.s3.model.1: Ndakasarudza nzira yokugovera mibvunzo kuvadzidzi vose 100. Inogona kusanganisira pfungwa dzevadzidzi vose, saka inoratidza zvose zvakanaka. Asi kana vamwe vadzidzi vasingapi mibvunzo, pane mugumo wokuti pfungwa dzavo dzinosiiwa.
y-m-15-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kunyange ukasarudza imwe nzira, wakanyora chikonzero nomugumo pamwe chete.

y-m-15-06.title: Mubhokisi rine tsvuku yakawanda zvikuru, tsvuku ndiyo yakanyanya kuwanikwa here?
y-m-15-06.topic: Kuenzanisa mikana: kuva nezvakawanda zvichienzaniswa nomukana mukuru
y-m-15-06.goal: Kana uchienzanisa mabhokisi emabhulu, simbisa uye utsanangure nomuenzaniso unopikisa kuti unofanira kuenzanisa chikamu chinotorwa netsvuku pachose, kwete huwandu hwemabhulu etsvuku chete.
y-m-15-06.material:
Pane mabhokisi matatu ane mabhulu ose akaenzana muhukuru nomuchimiro. Kubva mubhokisi rimwe nerimwe uchavhara maziso uye utore bhulu rimwe. Bhulu rimwe nerimwe ritsvuku kana bhuruu.

| Bhokisi | Huwandu hwemabhulu | Mabhulu matsvuku |
| 가 | 5 | 4 |
| 나 | 10 | 7 |
| 다 | 8 | 5 |

Yuna akati, “Bhokisi 나 rine mabhulu matsvuku akawanda zvikuru, 7, saka tsvuku ndiyo inowanikwa zvikuru muBhokisi 나.”
y-m-15-06.thinking.1: Kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa apo pane zvakawanda asi mukana uri wakaderera
y-m-15-06.prereq.0: Kunyora chikamu chose sechikamu; kuenzanisa hukuru hwezvikamu (nhanho yeGiredhi 5)
y-m-15-06.prereq.1: Chirevo chokutora chimwe uchivhara maziso: bhulu rega rega rine mukana wakaenzana wokusarudzwa
y-m-15-06.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi pamabhokisi matatu ine mukana wakakwirira zvikuru wokubuda bhulu dzvuku?
y-m-15-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pabhokisi rega rega, nyora ‘mangani pamabhulu ose ari matsvuku’ sechikamu nenzira imwe chete.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja zvikamu kuva madhesimali kana uite kuti vaparadzanisi vave vamwe chete, uye uenzanise hukuru hwazvo.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.o.a: Bhokisi 나 (nokuti rine tsvuku yakawanda zvikuru, 7)
y-m-15-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakatarisa chete kuti huwandu hwered ndihwo hukuru. Huwandu hwemabhora hwese hunosiyana pakati pemabhokisi. Enzanisa chikamu chinotorwa nered chehuwandu hwese.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.o.b: Bhokisi 가 (nekuti red inotora chikamu chikuru zvikuru chemabhora ese)
y-m-15-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakatonga kwete nehuwandu asi nechikamu chaenzaniswa nehuwandu hwese. Kunyange kana mabhokisi akasiyana muhukuru, anogona kuenzaniswa nechiyero chimwechete.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.o.c: Bhokisi 다 (nekuti ndiro rine blue shoma yakasanganiswa, 3)
y-m-15-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakangotarisa huwandu hwe blue. Kunyange kana blue i shoma, kana huwandu hwese hwakadzika, chikamu che red chinochinja.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.o.d: Mabhokisi ese matatu akafanana (nekuti mabhokisi ese ane red)
y-m-15-06.s.s1.r.d: Kungova ne red hakuiti kuti uenzanise hukuru hwemikana.
y-m-15-06.s.s1.explain: Mukana wekuti red ibude unoenzaniswa nechikamu che red muhuwandu hwese. Bhokisi 가 rine 4 pa 5, saka 4/5=0.8; Bhokisi 나 rine 7/10=0.7; Bhokisi 다 rine 5/8=0.625. Saka Bhokisi 가 ndiro rakakwirira zvikuru.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira zviitiko 3 zvakasiyana apo ‘bhokisi rine red yakawanda rinewo mukana wakakwira wekuti red ibude’ rakaipa. Bhokisi rekutanga i r1/t1 (r1 red pa t1 mabhora ese) uye bhokisi rechipiri i r2/t2. Bhokisi rekutanga rine red yakawanda, asi mukana wayo we red unofanira kuva wakadzika. Mabhora ese i 20 kana kushoma, uye bhokisi rekutanga rinofanira kuva ne blue 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ita kuti huwandu hwese hwebhokisi rekutanga hukure uye huwandu hwayo hwe red hukure zvishoma chete kupfuura hwebhokisi rechipiri.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora chikamu che red chebhokisi rimwe nerimwe sedecimal uye utarise kuti rekutanga i rakadzika.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba dzemabhora i natural numbers uye i 20 kana kushoma.

y-m-15-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Red haipfuuri huwandu hwese, uye bhokisi rekutanga rine blue zvakare.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Red haigone kupfuura huwandu hwese, uye bhokisi rekutanga rinofanira kuva ne blue 1 kana kupfuura.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwe red mubhokisi rekutanga hunofanira kuva hukuru kupfuura hwebhokisi rechipiri.
y-m-15-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Mukana wekuti red ibude mubhokisi rekutanga i wakadzika.

y-m-15-06.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana bhokisi rekutanga rine red 7 pa 10 (0.7) uye bhokisi rechipiri rine red 4 pa 5 (0.8), bhokisi rekutanga rine red yakawanda asi mukana wakadzika. 6/15=0.4 ne 4/5=0.8, 5/12 ne 2/3, ne 9/20 ne 5/8 zvinoshandawo.
y-m-15-06.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangurira Yuna kuti chii chinofanira kuenzaniswa kana uchienzanisa mikana, uchishandisa muenzaniso wawagadzira pamusoro kana nhamba dzeBhokisi 가 neBhokisi 나.
y-m-15-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wataura mumashoko kuti Bhokisi 가 kana Bhokisi 나 rinoita kuti red ibude nyore, wobva wasimbisa chikonzero nenhamba.

y-m-15-06.s.s3.model.1: Kuva nezvakawanda hakureve mukana mukuru. 4/5=0.8 uye 7/10=0.7, saka Bhokisi 가 rakakwira. Unofanira kuenzanisa neratio, uye unogona kuenzanisa huwandu chete kana huwandu hwese hwakafanana.

y-m-15-07.title: Sei mabhari achioneka akasiyana muhurefu kunyange mamakisi akafanana?
y-m-15-07.topic: Kuverenga bar graphs: kwotangira scale nemufungo wehurefu hwebhari
y-m-15-07.goal: Ziva kuti hurefu hwemabhari edata imwechete hunoratidzika hwakasiyana zvichienderana nemutengo wotangira vertical scale, wana uye ugadzirise kuverenga kunokonzera kunzwisisa zvisizvo, uye unyore musoro unozivisa pasina kukonzera kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-15-07.material:
Avhareji yeyuniti test yeKirasi 1 mugiredhi re5 i mapoinzi 82, uye avhareji yeKirasi 2 i mapoinzi 85. Wakadhirowa data imwechete mumabar graph maviri echikoro nyaya. Mabhari ese anobva pasi achikwira.
- Graph ㉮: Vertical scale inotanga pa 0 mapoinzi ichikwira kusvika ku 100 mapoinzi, ne 10 mapoinzi pagoko rimwe.
- Graph ㉯: Vertical scale inotanga pa 80 mapoinzi ichikwira kusvika ku 90 mapoinzi, ne 1 poinzi pagoko rimwe. Chikamu chiri pasi pe 80 mapoinzi hachidhirowwi, uye mabhari anoratidza chikamu chinokwira pamusoro pe 80 mapoinzi chete.

Doun akatarisa graph ㉯ uye akatsanangura seanotevera.
y-m-15-07.thinking.1: Kuongorora kuti chii chinofanira kuitwa kana graph yadhindwa sezvayakaita
y-m-15-07.prereq.0: Kuverenga vertical scale nehurefu hwebhari mubar graph (giredhi re4)
y-m-15-07.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa kuti nhamba imwe i ka kangani yeimwe (hukama hwekuwanza nekupatsanura)
y-m-15-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakaipa mutsananguro yaDoun. (Verenga mitsetse uchitanga ne 1.)
y-m-15-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tsanangura mumashoko, pasina mufananidzo, kana chikamu chemabhari mugraph ㉯ chiri pasi pe 80 mapoinzi chingaonekwa.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mamakisi eKirasi 2 nemamakisi eKirasi 1 padivi pedivi uye ufungidzire kuti rimwe makisi i ka kangani yeiri rimwe.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.line.0: Mugraph ㉯, vertical scale inotanga pa 80 mapoinzi, ne 1 poinzi pagoko rimwe.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.line.1: Bhari reKirasi 1 rakadhirowa 82-80=2 magoko kukwirira, uye bhari reKirasi 2 i 85-80=5 magoko kukwirira.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.line.2: 5 magoko i ka2.5 ye 2 magoko, saka makisi eKirasi 2 i ka2.5 emakisi eKirasi 1.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.line.3: Mugraph ㉮, musiyano wehurefu hwemabhari maviri unoratidzika mudiki zvikuru kana wakaenzaniswa nehurefu hwemabhari.
y-m-15-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 wakaipa. Mugraph ㉯ hurefu hwebhari hunoratidza chikamu chinokwira pamusoro pe 80 mapoinzi chete, saka ratio ye 5 magoko ku 2 magoko (ka2.5) haisi ratio yemamakisi. Kuenzanisa mamakisi 85 ne 82 kunopa anenge ka1.04, iri padyo nekufanana. Mutsetse 4 wakarurama. Mugraph ㉮, inotanga pa 0 mapoinzi, mabhari maviri anoratidzika anenge akareba zvakafanana.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kudhinda graph ㉯ muchikoro nyaya. Sarudza nzira dzese dzakakodzera dzekudzivirira shamwari dzinoverenga kuti dzisanzwisise zvisizvo.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, funga ‘izvi zvinoita kuti shamwari inoverenga itonge nehurefu hwebhari chete zvakawanda kana zvishoma?’
y-m-15-07.s.s2.hint.1: Wana nzira ipi inoita kuti vanhu vazive musiyano chaiwo pakati pemamakisi 82 ne 85.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.o.a: Nyora mumashoko kuti vertical scale inotanga pa 80 mapoinzi, kana isa break mark pasi pe scale
y-m-15-07.s.s2.r.a: Kutaura kuti scale inotangira kupi kunobatsira vaverengi kuti varege kuverenga hurefu hwebhari semakisi pachawo.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.o.b: Ruvara bhari reKirasi 2 chete neruvara rwakasviba kuti rioneke
y-m-15-07.s.s2.r.b: Kushandisa ruvara rwakasiyana kunowedzera mufungo wehurefu. Hairi nzira yekuderedza kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.o.c: Chinjira kudhinda graph ㉮, ine scale inotanga pa 0 mapoinzi
y-m-15-07.s.s2.r.c: Kana mutengo wekutanga we scale wakaiswa pa 0, ratio yehurefu hwemabhari inoswedera padyo neratio yemamakisi.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.o.d: Nyora musoro wegraph se ‘Kirasi 2 i ka2.5 yakakwira kupfuura Kirasi 1’
y-m-15-07.s.s2.r.d: Uku i kutaura kunoverenga zvisizvo ratio yehurefu hwemabhari seratio yemamakisi.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.o.e: Nyorawo nhamba 82 mapoinzi ne 85 mapoinzi pamabhari
y-m-15-07.s.s2.r.e: Kuratidza nhamba pamwe chete kunoita kuti vaverengi vaverenge mitengo zvakananga pachinzvimbo chekutonga nemufungo wehurefu chete.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.explain: Kutaura mutengo wekutangira we scale (a), kuishandura kuti itange pa 0 (c), uye kunyora nhamba pamwe chete (e) zvese zvinoderedza kunzwisisa zvisizvo kunokonzerwa nehurefu hwebhari. Ruvara rwakasviba (b) kana musoro sa ‘ka2.5’ (d) zvinowedzera kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.acc.0: Kudhinda graph ㉯ sezvayakaita uchitaurawo mutengo wekutangira we scale nemamakisi inzirawo yakakodzera yekuderedza kunzwisisa zvisizvo. Zvinonyanya kunaka kana yabatanidzwa nekuchinjira kugraph inotanga pa 0.
y-m-15-07.s.s2.acc.1: Kushandura scale kuita 0 uye kunyora mamakisi pamwe chete inzirawo yakakodzera.
y-m-15-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora musoro mutsva wenhau wemutsetse mumwe wechikoro nyaya. Unofanira kuzivisa mamakisi eKirasi 1 neKirasi 2 sezvazviri, pasina kukonzera kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-15-07.s.s3.hint.0: Shandisa 82 ne 85 sezvazviri, uye uwedzere chimwe chinhu chimwe: musiyano pakati pemamakisi maviri i mapoinzi mangani.
y-m-15-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti shamwari isingazivi scale ingatora sei musiyano wemamakisi kana ichiverenga musoro wawapedza.
y-m-15-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kubva pamusoro oga, unogona kuona kuti musiyano pakati pe 82 ne 85 mapoinzi hauzi mukuru here?
y-m-15-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora mamakisi zvakananga, kuti kunyange shamwari isina kuona graph irege kunzwisisa zvisizvo here?
y-m-15-07.s.s3.model.0: Kirasi 1 ine avhareji ye 82 mapoinzi uye Kirasi 2 ine avhareji ye 85 mapoinzi, musiyano we 3 mapoinzi
y-m-15-07.s.s3.model.1: Kirasi 2 i 3 mapoinzi pamusoro peKirasi 1 (graph scale inotanga pa 80 mapoinzi)
y-m-15-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndakataura musiyano uye kunyange kwotangira scale.
y-m-15-07.s.s3.model.2: Kirasi 1 yakawana 82 mapoinzi uye Kirasi 2 yakawana 85 mapoinzi, saka mamakisi emakirasi maviri akafanana
y-m-15-07.s.s3.modelNote.2: Ndakanyora nhamba pamwe chete nekutonga kwekuti ‘akafanana’. Muverengi ndiye anosarudza kana shoko rekuti ‘akafanana’ rakakodzera.
